first.text: Another Hunter. Brought me something broken? I repair, I buy as is, or I take it on consignment and we split what it fetches.

text: Brought me something broken? Let's see it.

consign.text: You leave it with me. I mend it and sell it. Take the repair off the price, and we halve what's left. You're paid now; I wait for the buyer.

windcatcher.text: It holds Jodebris. Out in the miasma there are no Chorus Winds, so your artifacts go dead unless you carry some with you.
